info.title: API.SH: Douban
info.description: The Douban API from API.SH: public Douban data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

notes.title: 三体内容的整理与思考1
notes.abstract: 看完刘慈欣的“地球往事”三部曲之后，我被深深的震撼和吸引了。正如大刘本人所说的那样，好看的科幻小说应该是把最空灵最疯狂的想象写的像新闻报道一般真实。我觉得三体就是这样的一部科幻小说。它对于我的吸引力之大，使得我第一次愿意在读完一本书之后马上再读第二遍，并对书中的所有我感兴趣的细节…
notes.chapter: 三体内容的整理与思考1

notes.title: 第202页 24.红岸之六
notes.abstract: 无限长的曲线就是宇宙的抽象，一头连着无限的过去，另一头连着无限的未来，中间只有无规律无生命的随机起伏，一个个高低错落的波峰就像一粒粒大小不等的沙子，整条曲线就像是所有沙粒排成行形成的一维沙漠，荒凉寂寥，长得更令人无法忍受。你可以沿着它向前向后走无限远，但永远找不到归宿。

get.description:
One Douban subject with everything its page shows: title, original title and other names, year, intro, rating (value, votes, stars) with the 1-5 star distribution and genre rank (better than x% of crime films), watched / watching / want-to counts, comment and review counts, genres, tags, countries, languages, release dates, honours and charts it is on, cover and link. Movies and TV add directors, actors, runtimes, episode count and trailers; books add authors, translators, publisher, pages, price, author intro, table of contents, series and reading-note count; music adds artists, label, media, versions and the track list; games add platforms, developers, publishers and release date. `raw` has the site's full record.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/douban-subject

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
